title: Stability measures: core, repository reads (lines, churn, CI, Waiting) and registry placement
description:
## As asked

**Piece 1 of 5 (the plan's P1.1, P1.2 and P1.6): the measuring core, the repository reads, and registry placement.** This lands as its own PR, the first part of the plan's PR 1.

### Slice of the approved plan

* `scripts/stability-measures-core.mjs` (D5) holds only pure functions. It takes numstat records, shape totals at two commits, Waiting counts and CI runs, and returns the ordered reading. Later pieces add the tracker inputs. It does no I/O.
* `scripts/stability-measures.mjs <repo> <base> <head> [--runner <dir>] [--api <base>] [--blind <signs.json>]` prints JSON on stdout and the ordered opening table on stderr. This piece builds the argument parsing and these reads:
  * **Lines (D2).** Import `scripts/code-shape/shape-core.mjs` and `code-shape-lib.mjs` (`git`, `listBlobs`, `readBlobs`, `compileScope`), not copies of them. Scope is `^(server\.js$|(lib|routes|public)/.*\.[cm]?js$)` with the kit's default excludes. Net growth is the shape difference between the endpoints (code, comment-only and blank apart), with the comment-only share at both ends.
  * **Churn.** First-parent `--numstat --no-renames` on the same scope. The denominator is first-parent landings. Report added and deleted per landing and the deleted/added ratio.
  * **CI median** via `gh`: successful `test.yml` runs on main whose head SHA is a window landing; duration is `updatedAt − startedAt`.
  * **Waiting.** Count `- ` bullets under `## Waiting` in `docs/areas/*.md`, read from git objects. Report totals at base and head and the change per landing, for Harbour and the runner separately and summed. The runner endpoints are the last commits on its checked-out branch at or before the repository endpoints' commit times.
  * Rows 1 and 3–5 are built by later pieces. Until then they print `not measured: not built yet`.
* **Placement (D7, review note 8).** Add `^scripts/stability-measures(-core)?\.mjs$` to Reports & operator tools in `docs/areas/areas.json`. Add a placement test: both files map there, and `scripts/steady-base-code.mjs` and `scripts/code-shape/verbatim.mjs` stay unmapped. Change the "no `docs/` or `scripts/` patterns" sentence in `docs/areas/README.md` to "only a few named scripts, each by exact pattern". Re-file no existing entry.

### Testing

`tests/unit/stability-measures.test.js` imports the core.

* **Counter fixture:** code, comment-only, blank, and a code line with a trailing comment, which counts as code. The split must match `shape-core`.
* **Unreadable sources:** a missing runner or an unreadable `gh` produces `not measured: <reason>`, never 0.
* **Live reproduction:** run on `5334c81a..9574d537` with `--runner` at the simple-dispatcher checkout. It must give 114 landings; 10,235 added and 3,677 deleted; net 6,558 (code +3,034, comment-only +3,185, blank +339); totals 200,226 → 206,784; +57.5 net per landing; ratio 0.36; comment-only share 39.44% → 39.73%; Waiting Harbour 0 → 56 and runner 10 at `5d8489e`.

### Retires

Nothing yet. Per-run script copying is retired by the declaration (piece 4).

---

**Parent:** LIN-4399, "The Stability Review opens with the five measures, per piece of work rather than per week". Its approved plan is this piece's starting point. Read it in full in LIN-4399's description, under `## Implementation Plan` (D1–D7, "The five measures", "The pieces, in landing order", "Likeliest ways it breaks"). Also read the eight builder notes in the approving plan review (LIN-4399 comment `6a7398bc-3855-419b-ae29-077b328d3543`). Follow the plan. Where the code shows it wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4399.

Session fit: fits one session
Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4399's approving plan-review (comment 6a7398bc-3855-419b-ae29-077b328d3543, rev 1: the plan at `30a019289`, its only revision)
Grounding commit: `30a019289` (LinearViewer main; the plan and the review both re-measured here). Reference window `5334c81a..9574d537`; runner pin `5d8489e`.

Constraints from the parent that apply to every piece:

* Reuse the registry's Acorn counter. Never copy it or add a second one.
* A missing or unreadable source prints `not measured: <reason>`, and a partial read shows its unreadable count. Never estimate, and never zero-fill.
* Proxy reads honour 429 `Retry-After` and stay within 60 calls a minute.
* Do not touch `package.json`, `CLAUDE.md`, Recent Headwinds or `scripts/steady-base-code.mjs`.

*End of what was asked. Steps write below this line; nothing above it changes.*

**Order of landing:** LIN-4420 → LIN-4421 → LIN-4422 → LIN-4423 → LIN-4424. This is piece 1 (LIN-4420), first; nothing blocks it. References to "piece N" above follow this order.

## Size of the move

**Size:** a small tidy
**Why:** Delivers the measuring core and repository reads as asked, plus first moving the area notes' Waiting definition out of their guard test into one shared place both read; a second copy recreates the competing counts the parent ends.
**Cuts:** none
**Decided by:** the standing policy

## Outcome

Implemented and merged: PR [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2398](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2398>) (merge `218ab7f64`, deployed). It holds the pure core `scripts/stability-measures-core.mjs`, the CLI `scripts/stability-measures.mjs` (lines, churn, CI, Waiting), placement under Reports & operator tools, and the Waiting definition shared in `lib/prompts/area-note-format.js`. Built as approved under LIN-4399's plan. The one deviation: close-out made the runner freshness check ask origin (`ls-remote`) before calling a checkout stale. The 8 Nov reproduction matches every target on the merged code. Follow-up for John's ruling on the overlapping measurers: LIN-4425. Full history is preserved in the task snapshots and the comment trail.

comments.body:
## Survey open-0: LIN-4420 @ 30a019289

Base is the grounding commit. I re-ran the reads in a scratch worktree there.

**The numbers reproduce.** `shape.mjs` on the D2 scope reads 200,226 at `5334c81a` and 206,784 at `9574d537`, with 0 parse failures at either end. First-parent numstat gives 114 landings and 10,235 / 3,677. Waiting reads 0 → 56. The runner endpoints resolve by committer time to `9478e1c53` (0) and `5d8489e` (10). The difficulty is three places where the obvious code gives a plausible wrong number:

1. **Merge landings.** 14 of the 114 landings are true merges. On git 2.46, `--first-parent` implies `--diff-merges=first-parent`. With merge diffs off, the read gives 8,590 / 3,055 and nothing else looks wrong. Pass `--diff-merges=first-parent` explicitly, and filter paths with `compileScope` in JS, not a git pathspec, so churn and shape share one scope.
2. **CI has no reproduction target, and the 8 Nov figure won't match.** The plan calls its rule run 5's `measure_ci.py` rule. It isn't. Run 5 took every successful main run by `startedAt` date (11-05..08, n=101, 8.55). The head-SHA rule gives 114 runs, median **8.59**. Record 8.59 and name the definition gap; don't chase 8.55. Also bound `gh run list` with `--created`, not only `--limit 1000`. At about 25 runs a day, the window falls off a 1000-row page in about six weeks, and a re-run would quietly match fewer runs. Report matched runs short of landings as a partial read.
3. **Zero vs not measured.** The reference needs Waiting = 0 at both bases, because `docs/areas/` didn't exist yet. The constraint says never zero-fill. The core needs two separate states: "commit readable, no notes directory → 0" and "runner missing, git fails or `gh` unreadable → `not measured: <reason>`". Pieces 2–4 add tracker rows with the same three states (value, partial read with an unreadable count, not measured). So the core's **row shape** is this piece's real deliverable. Settle `{key, value, reference, status, reason, unreadable}` before writing reads.

Smaller:
- The comment-only share is over *all* lines, blanks included (78,976 / 200,226 = 39.44%), not over code+comment (42.5%). Pin the denominator in a test.
- The README sentence goes on: "because one would change the code-shape census and co-change counts". Reword the whole sentence, not just its first clause. The LIN-3829 test (`tests/unit/area-map-placement.test.js:56`) is a ready template for the placement test.
- The runner read follows "its checked-out branch". A checkout on a feature branch changes the reading, so print the branch and the resolved SHAs in the JSON.
- The live reproduction needs `gh` and two checkouts, so it can't be a unit test. Put its output in the PR.

**First:** write the row type and the three-state tests. Then write the numstat read with explicit `--diff-merges` and check it against 10,235 / 3,677, before touching `gh`.

Not a symptom ticket. The plan's diagnosis (each run rebuilds its own measuring) holds, and this piece is the direct fix.

## Survey global: LIN-4420 @ 30a019289

Base is the grounding commit, so the plan was measured on the tree I read.

**Where it lands.** Two new files in `scripts/`, which holds about 236 files. In the last month 52 were added and 1 deleted, mostly one-off `survey-*` and `steady-base-*` measurers, each with its own `git` wrapper and regex counter. Some of those already measure what this ticket measures: `steady-base-code.mjs` and `survey-growth-git.mjs` (production lines, comment share) and `survey-growth-ci.mjs` (CI median via `gh`). The code-shape kit is the tidy part: small cores, a shared lib, tests on every core. Building on it is right. The directory as a whole is getting worse by accretion.

**What the obvious build would do.**
- *A second rollup.* The ticket names `shape-core`. But `measureShape` in `shape-report.mjs` already sums code, comment and blank lines across files and records `parseFailures`. Calling `analyse` per file rebuilds that loop. Import `measureShape` through `loadCore`, and show `parseFailures.length` as the partial-read count instead of dropping those files silently.
- *A second Waiting parser.* `parseNote` in `tests/unit/area-notes.test.js` already defines a waiting entry. A script can't import a test, so the core would hold a second definition with nothing keeping the two in step. Cheap fix: a small pure leaf beside `lib/prompts/area-registry-path.js` that both import, skipping `README.md`/`areas.json` the way `NOT_NOTES` does.
- *The runner read depends on local state.* "Checked-out branch" means a stale or feature-branch checkout gives a quietly smaller count. The runner checkout here is `main` at 2026-11-11T22:26Z. A head endpoint later than the runner's tip should read `not measured: runner checkout older than head`.
- *`gh` caps.* `survey-growth-ci.mjs` notes that the runs listing stops at 1,000. Show the matched-run count beside the median, so a truncated listing is visible.

**Registry and docs.** The README already contradicts itself: "a few named scripts", then "no `docs/` or `scripts/` patterns". Meanwhile `areas.json` already maps `pipeline-churn.mjs` and `retention(-core).mjs`. The planned sentence change fixes an existing error. The new pattern shifts Reports & operator tools' seam and co-change counts, which is the LIN-3829 trade. Only the placement test would catch a misfiling.

**What notices if later pieces stall.** Nothing. The Stability Review prompt (`lib/periodicals.js`) still says "introducing no new tooling" and doesn't name the script. Until piece 4, the live-reproduction test is its only caller.

**Better, affordable here.** Use `measureShape`. Share `parseNote` through one leaf. Give the stale-runner case its own `not measured` reason.

**Better still, not this ticket's.** Retire the regex counters (`survey-growth-git`, `survey-growth-ci`, `steady-base-check`'s comment share) once this tool covers them. `steady-base-code.mjs` is fenced off here. The `scripts/` root collects measurers and almost never deletes one. That needs a retirement habit, not another tool.

### Leftovers

PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2398, head `2e50af1c9e87d4a13c9fc8bcaaf081d252986e89`. CI is green.

- **Stale-runner check** (`scripts/stability-measures.mjs`): noted. It is a `## Waiting` entry in `docs/areas/reports-and-operator-tools.md`. The check compares only the runner tip's time with head, so a runner that is up to date but has had no commit since head reads not measured.
- **Lessons:** added two under `## Lessons` in the same note:
  - not measured vs a measured zero, the row shape, and `countWaiting`;
  - `--diff-merges=first-parent` explicit, with `compileScope` for the scope.
- **Old regex measurers** now overlap the committed tool: `scripts/survey-growth-git.mjs` (production lines, comment share), `scripts/survey-growth-ci.mjs` (CI median) and the comment share in `scripts/steady-base-check*`. For close-out: they sit outside the area (unmapped scripts), and retiring them is John's call. `scripts/steady-base-code.mjs` stays fenced off.
- **Copies, untrue names or comments, rules spelled twice:** none left. The Waiting definition has one home (`lib/prompts/area-note-format.js`), and the guard's copy was removed in the PR.

## Review — LIN-4420

PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2398, head `2e50af1c9e87d4a13c9fc8bcaaf081d252986e89` (base `30a019289`, still `origin/main`; nothing the ticket references has changed on main since the ticket was created).

CI: green on `2e50af1c9`: `CI success`, Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4 and Secret scan all SUCCESS (run 43180569745).

### What I checked myself

**Live reproduction, re-run at this head:** `node scripts/stability-measures.mjs . 5334c81a 9574d537 --runner ../simple-dispatcher`. The runner was on `main`, tip `7d6c5c6`. Every target matches:
- 114 landings;
- 10,235 added and 3,677 deleted; ratio 0.36;
- net +6,558 (code +3,034, comment-only +3,185, blank +339); +57.5 per landing;
- totals 200,226 → 206,784;
- comment-only share 39.44% → 39.73%;
- Waiting: Harbour 0 → 56; runner 0 → 10 (`9478e1c53..5d8489e7f`); total 66.

CI reads 8.59 min over 114 runs, with 114 of 114 landings matched. The JSON carries the runner's branch, tip and resolved endpoint SHAs, plus the `--created` bound (`2026-11-04..2026-11-09`).

**Unreadable sources, driven through the CLI rather than only the core:**
- `--runner /nonexistent` gives `waiting.runner not measured: runner checkout not found at /nonexistent`, and the total is not measured too.
- No `gh` on PATH gives `ci not measured: gh unreadable: spawnSync gh ENOENT`.
- A `gh` that prints non-JSON gives `ci not measured: gh run list output unreadable…`.
- No runner given gives `not measured: no --runner given`.
- None of these reads 0.

**Mutation check (LIN-2274).** I applied each mutation alone, ran `stability-measures`, `area-map-placement` and `area-notes`, and reverted it. Every one went red:
- comment share computed over code+comment;
- churn without the scope filter;
- in-scope binary counted as 0 instead of unreadable;
- `parseFailures` dropped;
- CI without the SHA match;
- CI missing landings not counted as partial;
- runner `reason` zero-filled;
- `gh` null zero-filled;
- `isNoteFile` accepting `README.md`;
- `parseNote` counting nested bullets;
- the areas.json pattern removed (4 fails);
- the `minted` placeholder dropped.

**Gap analysis against `## As asked`:**
- **Core is pure.** No I/O imports. Met.
- **CLI.** It takes the usage as asked, prints JSON on stdout and the table on stderr. Met.
- **Lines.** It goes through `measureShape` via `loadCore` and `readCommit` / `compileScope`, with no copied counter. It uses the D2 scope with the kit's default excludes, keeps code, comment-only and blank apart, and gives the share at both ends. Met.
- **Churn.** First-parent, `--numstat --no-renames`, with `--diff-merges=first-parent` passed explicitly. Scope is filtered in JS. The denominator is all landings. Met.
- **CI.** `gh` reads successful `test.yml` runs on main, matches on head SHA and uses `updatedAt − startedAt`. Met. 8.59 vs 8.55 is a difference of definition, recorded on LIN-4399; it is not a defect.
- **Waiting.** Read from git objects, for Harbour and the runner apart and summed, as totals plus the change per landing. Met. The runner endpoint resolution is met, with the freshness caveat in the ledger.
- **Unbuilt rows.** Rows 1 and 3–5 and `minted` print `not measured: not built yet`. Met.
- **Placement.** The exact pattern is in Reports & operator tools. The placement test also pins `steady-base-code.mjs` and `verbatim.mjs` as unmapped, plus a non-prefix guard. The README sentence is reworded whole. Nothing is re-filed. Met.
- **Tests.** The counter fixture includes the trailing-comment line, checked against `analyse`. The unreadable-source tests exist. Met. The live reproduction is in the PR and re-run above. Met.
- **Constraints.** `package.json`, `CLAUDE.md`, Recent Headwinds and `steady-base-code.mjs` are untouched. There is no second Acorn counter. Met. The "Proxy reads / 429" constraint does not apply yet, because this piece makes no proxy reads (`--api` is only recorded).
- **Size-of-move addition.** The Waiting definition moved to `lib/prompts/area-note-format.js`, and the guard imports it, so there is one definition. Met.

**Regression check.** `git log -30` on each touched file shows no fix being undone and nothing reverted being re-applied. `area-notes.test.js` has had only its LIN-4371 creation, and the moved `parseNote` is byte-identical to the original.

**Isolated, or one of a class?** The class is "measurers that each rebuild their own counting". Its other instances (`scripts/survey-growth-git.mjs`, `scripts/survey-growth-ci.mjs`, the comment share in `scripts/steady-base-check*`) are **outside** this ticket's bounded classes. The ask says "Retires: nothing yet", and retiring them is John's call. Close-out should file one follow-up for John's retirement ruling if none exists. Inside the ticket's class (one Waiting definition), I searched for other `## Waiting` parsers in `lib/`, `scripts/` and `tests/` and found none left.

**Leftovers** (against the builder's `### Leftovers`):
- The stale-runner note is re-homed as a ledger item below. It is a defect in this ticket's own runner read, so it does not belong in the area note.
- The CLI glue (`readRunner`, `readCiRuns`, the numstat flags) has no automated test. Removing `--diff-merges=first-parent` would leave the suite green, and only the live run catches it. The ask chose the live reproduction as that witness, so this is a note, not a defect. Proposed `## Waiting` wording for `docs/areas/reports-and-operator-tools.md`: "`scripts/stability-measures.mjs`: its reads (numstat flags, runner endpoint resolution, `gh` listing) are witnessed only by the hand-run reproduction; a fixture-repo test would pin `--diff-merges=first-parent` against silent undercount."

### What CI Did Not Prove

- **Runner Waiting is measurable on a current window. Inside** (the ask's Waiting bullet: runner endpoints at or before the repository endpoints). I reproduced it: `node scripts/stability-measures.mjs . 30a019289 HEAD --runner ../simple-dispatcher`, with the runner on an up-to-date `main` whose tip is older than head, gives `waiting.runner not measured: runner checkout older than head (main tip 2026-11-11T22:26:01Z < 2026-11-12T08:08:42Z)`, and the total is not measured too. The Stability Review runs at HEAD, so this blanks the runner and total rows on most real runs. **Settle before the merge** with this close-out fix:
  - In `readRunner` (`scripts/stability-measures.mjs`), when `tipDate < headDate`, run `git -C <runner> ls-remote origin refs/heads/<branch>`.
    - If the remote SHA equals `source.tip`, or `merge-base --is-ancestor <remoteSha> HEAD` succeeds, the checkout is current. Record `source.upstreamSha` and proceed to endpoint resolution.
    - Otherwise keep the existing `runner checkout older than head` reason.
    - If `ls-remote` fails, the row reads `not measured: runner freshness unreadable: <first line>`.
  - Then delete the stale-runner `## Waiting` entry from `docs/areas/reports-and-operator-tools.md`.
  - **Distinguishing check:** with the runner at its current `origin/main`, the `30a019289..HEAD` command above must give `waiting.runner` measured. With a runner worktree checked out at an older commit (for example `main~5`, behind origin), it must still read `not measured: runner checkout older than head`. The 8 Nov reproduction must still give runner 0 → 10.
- **Live repository reads** (numstat with explicit merge diffs, the `gh` listing, the runner's git objects). **Inside** (the ask's Testing: the live reproduction). No CI job runs them. Discharged for head `2e50af1c9` by my re-run above. Close-out re-runs the 8 Nov reproduction on the final head after the runner fix and confirms the same figures.
- **Retiring the overlapping regex measurers. Outside**: a different problem, and John's call. Close-out files it as a follow-up for John's ruling, after checking none exists. It is not a condition on the merge.

### Verdict

Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger

The work meets every sentence of `## As asked`. The one inside gap is the runner freshness check. The builder added it on the Survey's advice, and it wrongly rejects an up-to-date runner, which blanks the runner and total Waiting rows on any window ending at HEAD. Close-out applies the named `ls-remote` fix and its two-sided check before the merge, then re-runs the 8 Nov reproduction on the final head.

## Close-out — LIN-4420

**Merged:** PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2398 as merge commit `218ab7f64` (pinned with `--match-head-commit 0cc0fd33e`). **Deployed:** the Harbour footer shows `218ab7f6474a0b61dbee8daca119874705c87c71`.

**How it meets the ask:** review's gap analysis (comment fa054c49) found every sentence of `## As asked` met at `2e50af1c9`: the pure core, the CLI reads (lines, churn, CI, Waiting), registry placement and tests. The only inside gap was runner freshness, fixed below.

### Changes made in close-out
- `0cc0fd33e` `fix(LIN-4420): runner freshness asks origin before calling a checkout stale`. This answers review's ledger item "Runner Waiting is measurable on a current window".
  - `readRunner` in `scripts/stability-measures.mjs`: when the tip is older than head, it runs `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/<branch>`.
    - Current when origin's SHA equals the tip, or `merge-base --is-ancestor` succeeds. `sources.runner.upstreamSha` is then recorded.
    - Otherwise it stays `runner checkout older than head`.
    - If `ls-remote` fails, or origin has no such branch, it reads `runner freshness unreadable: <first line>`.
  - `docs/areas/reports-and-operator-tools.md`: the stale-runner `## Waiting` entry is removed, as review asked. In its place is review's proposed note: the CLI reads are witnessed only by the hand-run reproduction, and a fixture-repo test would pin `--diff-merges=first-parent`.

### Ledger
- **Runner Waiting on a current window (inside):** settled by the fix and the two-sided check review named.
  - On the PR branch, window `30a019289..2e50af1c9`:
    - Current runner (tip `7d6c5c6`, 22:26 Nov 11, older than head at 08:08): `waiting.runner 12 → 12`, with `upstreamSha` recorded.
    - Clone reset to `main~5` (`be6e08b`), origin pointed at GitHub: `not measured: runner checkout older than head (main tip 2026-11-08T11:02:47Z < …)`.
    - Origin unreachable: `not measured: runner freshness unreadable: git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main: fatal: …`.
    - Detached HEAD: `runner freshness unreadable: origin has no refs/heads/HEAD`.
    - None of these reads 0, and the total is not measured whenever the runner isn't.
  - Again on the merge commit `218ab7f64`, window `30a019289..218ab7f64`:
    - Fresh clone of the runner at `a42456c` (tip 08:34, older than head at 08:36): `12 → 12`, `upstreamSha a42456c`.
    - The workspace checkout at `7d6c5c6`, by then really behind origin `a42456c`: `not measured: runner checkout older than head`.
- **Live repository reads (inside):** the 8 Nov reproduction was re-run on the final tree, both on the PR branch and from the merge commit `218ab7f64`: `node scripts/stability-measures.mjs . 5334c81a 9574d537 --runner ../simple-dispatcher`. Every target matches:
  - 114 landings;
  - 10,235 added, 3,677 deleted, ratio 0.36;
  - net +6,558 (code +3,034, comment-only +3,185, blank +339), +57.5 per landing;
  - totals 200,226 → 206,784;
  - comment-only share 39.44% → 39.73%;
  - Waiting: Harbour 0 → 56, runner 0 → 10 (`9478e1c53..5d8489e7f`), total 66;
  - CI 8.59 min over 114 of 114 landings.
- **Retiring the overlapping regex measurers (outside):** no existing ticket found. Searched for `survey-growth-git`, `survey-growth-ci`, the `steady-base-check` comment share and "retire measurers", plus LIN-4399 and sibling descriptions and rulings. Filed **LIN-4425** for John's ruling: priority Low; labels Improvement, kind:follow-up, kind:decision; linked `related` to this ticket.

### CI
- Green on `0cc0fd33e`: CI success, Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan (run 43182924716).
- `test.yml` green on main at the merge `218ab7f64`.
- Locally, before the push: `stability-measures`, `area-map-placement`, `area-notes`, `lin-4346-scoping-area-notes` and `lin-4377-area-notes-pointer-bytes` give 47/47 pass.

### Post-deploy
The change is an operator script; the deployed server doesn't run it. Verified on what landed by running it from the merge commit (above). No post-deploy step is left.

### Related tickets
- LIN-4421, which this blocked, is now unblocked; it stays Todo.
- The parent LIN-4399 and the other siblings stay open, since this piece settles none of them.
